title: Course: Advanced Higher
content:
Advanced Higher Chemistry — university-level, a year early

Advanced Higher is closer to first-year university than to Higher. Small-group tuition with Lynsey Robinson, a qualified Chemistry teacher and SQA marker with over 20 years' experience at this level.

What makes Advanced Higher different

Advanced Higher asks for something Higher never quite does: genuine independence. Pupils are expected to reason from principles, handle unfamiliar problems without a worked template, and carry out a substantial project largely under their own steam.

The content is also more abstract. Orbitals, thermodynamics and reaction mechanisms are the point at which Chemistry stops being describable in everyday terms, and pupils who got through Higher on strong memory often find that approach stops working.

Classes at this level are as much about how to think as what to know — and with genuinely small classes, there is room for the long discussions that this material genuinely needs.

The whole Advanced Higher course

Classes follow the SQA course through the year, then shift to past papers and exam technique as the exam approaches.

Inorganic & physical chemistry

  • Electromagnetic radiation and atomic spectra
  • Electronic configuration and orbitals
  • Transition metals and complexes
  • Thermodynamics and kinetics

Organic chemistry

  • Reaction mechanisms
  • Stereochemistry
  • Synthesis and retrosynthesis
  • Medicines and pharmacology

Instrumental analysis

  • Mass spectrometry
  • Infrared spectroscopy
  • NMR spectroscopy
  • Chromatography

Researching chemistry & the project

  • Planning the investigation
  • Practical technique and accuracy
  • Handling and presenting data
  • Writing up for marks

Course content follows the current SQA specification. Ask about the current year's arrangements.

Small groups. Real attention.

Small groups

Kept deliberately small. Everyone gets asked, everyone gets heard, and nobody sits quietly at the back not understanding.

Marked by an SQA marker

Lynsey marks for the SQA. Pupils learn how marks are actually awarded, and the phrasing that quietly loses them.

Real past papers

Exam technique is taught explicitly — how to read the question, how to structure an answer, how to handle the open-ended ones.

Included in every course

  • Revision materials for every topic on the course
  • Quizzes to check understanding as you go
  • Assessments under exam conditions
  • A weekly assessment, with feedback sent to parents

All of it is included in the price — there is nothing extra to buy.

Is this the right class?

This class suits pupils taking Advanced Higher Chemistry, particularly those heading for Medicine, Dentistry, Veterinary Medicine, Pharmacy or a Chemistry-related degree, where the grade carries real weight.

It is also the right place for a capable pupil who is finding that the study habits which carried them through Higher are no longer enough — which is extremely common at this level and not a sign of anything going wrong.

Support with the project is included. It is worth a substantial share of the final award and is the part pupils most often underestimate.
